title: Can Loan Processors and Underwriters Spot AI-Edited Statements? An Empirical Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.30758v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI-assisted editing can produce loan documents that preserve familiar issuer layouts while changing the applicant's identity. We investigated whether experienced underwriters and loan processors identify such forgeries in first-pass, document-only review. Three practitioners recruited through Upwork each received one applicant package drawn from 134 forged PDFs derived from 47 genuine financial documents supplied with full consent. The edits preserved amounts, dates and balances; identifier inconsistencies introduced by the pipeline were knowingly retained before distribution. Reviewers were not told that files had been altered and returned 132 file-level judgements. Checking their explanations against the originals yielded 14 edit-supported concerns (10.6%): 12 Suspicious judgements and two Insufficient information judgements. translated_title: 贷款处理员与贷款审核员能识别AI编辑的报表吗？一项实证研究
translated_abstract: AI辅助编辑可以在保留原发行方熟悉版式的同时更改申请人的身份，从而生成贷款文件。我们研究了经验丰富的贷款审核员和贷款处理员在首次审阅（仅基于文件本身）时能否识别此类伪造文件。通过Upwork招募的三位从业者，每人收到一份申请人材料包，这些材料包来自134份伪造的PDF文件，而这些PDF文件是在完全知情同意的前提下，基于47份真实财务文件生成的。编辑保留了金额、日期和余额；在分发之前，处理流程中引入的标识符不一致被有意保留。审阅者未被告知文件已被篡改，共返回了132份文件级判断。将他们的解释与原始文件核对后，共发现14处有编辑依据的疑虑（10.6%）：12个“可疑”判断和2个“信息不足”判断。所有有依据的疑虑均涉及文件内部或跨文件的标识符不一致，而没有报告的视觉…（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究通过实证实验发现，经验丰富的贷款审核员和处理员在仅凭文件的首次审阅中，仅有约10.6%的判断准确指出了AI伪造财务文件中的编辑痕迹（且全部依赖标识符不一致），表明仅靠人工文件审查很难发现AI编辑的伪造贷款文件。
en_tdlr: This empirical study shows that experienced loan underwriters and processors, in first-pass document-only reviews, identified only about 10.6% of AI-edited forged financial statements (all detected via identifier inconsistencies), indicating that manual document review alone rarely detects AI-forged loan documents.
